note: Owner authorization state. Agent research (docs/LICENSE_REVIEW.md) is evidence, never authorization. Every entry starts OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED with null decidedAt/decider; only an explicit owner statement flips one, with decider + date recorded. Fabrication of approval is a defect the validator rejects.

decisions.subject: GHSA
decisions.attribution: Per-record sourceUrl + CC-BY-4.0 credit (license link + change notes per batch)
decisions.redistribution: Permitted with BY conditions (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.commercialUse: Permitted with BY conditions (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.requiredDecision: Owner authorizes GHSA batches for production ingestion with CC-BY-4.0 attribution
decisions.eligibleScope: Reviewed-only, withdrawn-excluded npm+PyPI advisories; per-batch license-field resolution still required

decisions.subject: OSV
decisions.attribution: Per-record source + upstream home id (osv.dev entry and/or home record)
decisions.redistribution: Permitted only under each record's home terms (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.commercialUse: Permitted only under each record's home terms (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.requiredDecision: Owner authorizes OSV batches with per-record home-terms resolution and fail-closed exclusion
decisions.eligibleScope: npm+PyPI records whose home terms resolve to CC-BY-4.0 or public domain; all other homes excluded fail-closed. Never infer one license for all OSV records.

decisions.subject: NVD
decisions.licenseOrTerms: U.S. public domain (17 USC) + required notice + API Terms of Use for keys
decisions.attribution: Prominent product notice: This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
decisions.redistribution: Permitted as public-domain data with notice (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.commercialUse: Permitted as public-domain data with notice (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.requiredDecision: Owner confirms a verified consumer need AND authorizes API-key acquisition under the NVD Terms of Use
decisions.eligibleScope: None today: no verified consumer need; no key requested or used. Rate limits 5/50 per 30s with 6s sleep if ever used.

decisions.subject: CWE
decisions.licenseOrTerms: CWE Terms of Use (royalty-free research/development/commercial; reproduce notice on copies)
decisions.attribution: Canonical definition link per entry (no MITRE text copied)
decisions.redistribution: Permitted under the Terms of Use (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.commercialUse: Permitted under the Terms of Use (lay review; owner/counsel confirms)
decisions.requiredDecision: Owner confirms the own-words-plus-links scope needs no further clearance
decisions.eligibleScope: Own-words summaries + canonical links only. No MITRE text is copied; every derived field is original Drobon wording. Verbatim copying would need re-review.

decisions.subject: ORIGINAL_CONTENT
decisions.redistribution: No grant exists: all rights reserved by default
decisions.commercialUse: No grant exists: all rights reserved by default
decisions.requiredDecision: Owner chooses license(s) + scope for packs, remediation, lessons, templates, engagements, vectors, CWE summaries, planning docs
decisions.eligibleScope: None until the owner records the decision and adds the grant file(s)
